# Auto-generated by VerityQA Autonomous Investigation Agent
# Replayable Application Journey Test
import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, expect

def test_primary_discovered_progression():
    """
    Test Objective: Replay and verify the discovered application journey "Primary Discovered Progression".
    Preconditions: Application server is online and reachable.
    Evidence Grounding: Derived directly from empirical DOM observations and state transitions.
    """
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = browser.new_context()
        page = context.new_page()

        # Step 1: Navigate to entry view: http://127.0.0.1:8113/
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8113/', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        # Step 2: Populate authorized username
        page.locator('#username').fill('benchmark_user')
        # Step 3: Populate authorized password
        page.locator('#password').fill(__import__('os').environ['VERITYQA_TEST_PASSWORD'])
        # Step 4: Submit login authentication
        page.locator('#login-button').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        # Step 5: Trigger #add-to-cart-1 [Evidence: ev-3ba1667f]
        page.locator('#add-to-cart-1').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert '/cart' in page.url, f'Expected /cart in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Shopping Cart' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Shopping Cart'
        assert page.locator('a[href="/products"]').count() > 0
        # Step 6: Trigger #remove-item-1 [Evidence: ev-c3cef25d]
        page.locator('#remove-item-1').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert 'Shopping Cart' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Shopping Cart'
        assert page.locator('a[href="/products"]').count() > 0
        # Step 7: Trigger #calculate-tax-btn [Evidence: ev-f8e2f92d]
        page.locator('#calculate-tax-btn').click()
        page.wait_for_timeout(400)
        assert 'Shopping Cart' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Shopping Cart'
        assert page.locator('a[href="/products"]').count() > 0
        # Step 8: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8113/products?sort=az&menu=closed [Evidence: ev-1882a7df]
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8113/products?sort=az&menu=closed', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        assert 'Products Catalog' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Products Catalog'
        assert page.locator('a[href="/products"]').count() > 0
        # Step 9: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8113/products/1 [Evidence: ev-cca28849]
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8113/products/1', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        assert '/products/1' in page.url, f'Expected /products/1 in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Alpha Device Details' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Alpha Device Details'
        assert page.locator('a[href="/products"]').count() > 0
        # Step 10: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8113/checkout [Evidence: ev-477b0631]
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8113/checkout', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        assert '/checkout' in page.url, f'Expected /checkout in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Checkout: Shipping Details' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Checkout: Shipping Details'
        assert page.locator('a[href="/products"]').count() > 0
        # Step 11: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8113/products/2 [Evidence: ev-123e4565]
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8113/products/2', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        assert '/products/2' in page.url, f'Expected /products/2 in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert 'Beta Machine Details' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark Beta Machine Details'
        assert page.locator('a[href="/products"]').count() > 0

        # Verify final application state and DOM integrity
        assert page.url is not None and page.url.startswith('http')
        assert len(page.locator('body').inner_text().strip()) > 0
        browser.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_primary_discovered_progression()
    print('Journey replay completed successfully.')
